text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes... yes, understood! Please connect
the live
feeds from all of the stages.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's a resounding success across
the entire
venue. Part two is just about
to start, and with it...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: It's time for "Girls' Legend U."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the performance will take place not
only
here at stage A, but also at stages
B and C... all
stages at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Every performer across the event will be
singing
at the same time, and every fan
will be cheering
along.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. The technicians put a lot of hard
work into
this, so I'm certain it'll be a fun
time.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: For the girls, the fans... and you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Simultaneous performances on every one
of the
stages!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm devastated I won't be able to wave light sticks in worship of my oshis... But I get to be on stage too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Here I go... I'm gonna give everything
I've got to
make this day magical for my
oshis and fellow
fans! WOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's springtime or summer or
autumn or
winter, burn with hope and
ambition...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...And run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Heh, this song's funny, isn't it? In the
end, it
somehow comes back to running.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What else would you expect from a song
about
us? I think the lyrics turned out
great!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right! Deep breaths...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, everyone! Let's make sure
our song
and emotions are heard!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Woo.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You will gain power from this
performance, I'm sure of it! Now go
expand your potential, strengthen the
utility of your bonds, and overcome your
limits!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That goes for you too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We can't end it here—we're just getting
started!
C'mon, let's sing "Girls' Legend
U" together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now all that's left is to let "Girls'
Legend
U" play.
